Ava (CEO): Morning team — quick leadership snapshot for the week: priorities for the next 7 days: 1) reduce EU Private beta latency, 2) finalize Data Retention Policy v2, 3) ship Dedicated pricing update, 4) incident readout + mitigations. Details below.

Ava (CEO): Metrics callout — P95 gen latency (hosted) is 420ms, target 350ms; 5xx error rate ~0.6% last week (down from 0.9%). Cost per 1k tokens improved ~8% after batching pilot.

Ava (CEO): Policy change (effective 2026-05-01): hosted request logs >90d will be purged unless customer has a contract opt-in for 365d retention. Security/Legal to publish full text. Action: Product & Sales update self-serve copy + contract templates.

Priya (VP Product): On it — copy + UI change request by Mon EOD. @Lina any compliance/security blocker?

Lina (Head of Security): No blocker from Sec. Need one line about KMS rotation and an audit note; I'll add that to the doc.

Mateo (VP Eng): EU Private beta incident summary: spike caused by a fallback loop during region failover — routing policy preferred remote replica causing cache misses. Hotfix rolled at 03:22 UTC (routing preference) -> latency down ~120ms. Root-cause fix scheduled Wed.

Samir (Head of Infra): Patch plan: rollout across 6 shards Wed 02:00-06:00 UTC, can pause by shard if we see regressions. Support will be on rotation.

RJ (Finance): Pricing note: Dedicated tier revision target ship next Fri. Need eng estimate for cost delta to finalize invoice model. Mateo, can you share numbers by Tue?

Mateo (VP Eng): I'll post a short calc in #eng-costs by Tue noon — using batching gains + quantization profiles for typical workloads.

Ava (CEO): Launch guardrails: no GA after code-freeze without green from Reliability, Security, and Legal. If your team plans a GA in the next 3 weeks, ping me + @Priya and attach the rollout checklist.

deploy-bot: Deployment notice: canary rollout started for routing-hotfix 2213456795 on prod-cluster-3.

Ava (CEO): :thumbsup: Thanks all. Small comms ask: exec team will align on customer messaging — Priya to draft customer-facing note by Thu. If objections, DM me.

Priya (VP Product): Draft will be in #announcements-drafts by Wed.
